sections.advice: Lindau → Oberstaufen is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Oberstaufen → Oberjoch climbs about 1178 m in 39 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Oberjoch → Garmisch Partenkirchen drops about 1178 m over 62 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Garmisch Partenkirchen → Walchensee is 25 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 64 km this is German Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Oberstaufen → Oberjoch
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 78 km. 1178 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Romantische Strasse
scenicChapters.narrative: 125 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

german-alpine-road-lindau-walchensee.story: 317 km from Lindau to Schlehdorf, about 4 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: Oberstaufen, Oberjoch and Garmisch Partenkirchen. The highest point is about 1,550 m. Oberjoch is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Germany into Austria - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
